featured_reviews.name: Subhashini R
featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled my son with Clever Harvey at the end of 11th grade. In hindsight, this is too late to start meaningful profile building. I was swayed by their marketing, which promised that my son could still have a mentored project and a summer internship on his profile. Had they promised less and delivered on it, I would have been more inclined to recommend them.

They are reasonably helpful with essays and the college selection process—that’s pretty much what I got out of it.

I would advise parents to be cautious before signing up—understand exactly what is being offered, what is realistically achievable at this stage, and get clear commitments on deliverables.

featured_reviews.name: M Singal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have had experience with Clever Harvey since they started the Junior MBA program that was so amazing that our friends enrolled their kids in it as well.
Now that I have a senior in HS, they have been there every part of the way guiding, demystifying the US college application process. Their insight is refreshing and they are able to highlight the student's unique qualities and help them craft  authentic stories that stand out from the rest. I love their attention to detail and bedside manner.

featured_reviews.name: Aarav Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
“I recently completed the Junior MBA program with Clever Harvey, and it was an amazing experience! Working on projects with different companies was both exciting and insightful. The mentors were incredible—especially Vanessa Arez, who was truly outstanding. Her guidance and support made the entire learning process enjoyable and enriching. The program is filled with positivity, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to gain real-world business skills!”
Definitely recommended!!

featured_reviews.name: Akshita Nandivada
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve done quite a few courses at Clever Harvey. They have a wide range of courses with experienced mentors and hands on learning through group projects. I enjoyed it and I think many people with similar course interests as me may enjoy and learn so much from these courses as well!!

featured_reviews.name: Pranjal Valecha
featured_reviews.review_text: I had great time learning at Clever Harvey. Our teacher encouraged participation during the class. I never felt bored during the lecture. She was very considerate during the times I wasn’t able to answer in the class. It was a short program but I gained complete knowledge about business models and even gained practical knowledge about how large scale organisations work. I was lucky to find smart and friendly peers who made the experience all the more fun.

featured_reviews.name: suhani
featured_reviews.review_text: The mentors were really helpful and I had a great experience with clever Harvey! They gave me guidance through my entire experience writing a research paper. I highly recommend working with them.

featured_reviews.name: Danielle Dsilva
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a fun experience cause we are getting to learn a lot. Plus the teaching staff is amazing and all the staff in general are really humble and kind. It's just been 3, weeks since I've joined and I've enjoyed a lot. The teachers make the sessions really enjoyable. And this is one of the best classes I've joined so far.

featured_reviews.name: Om Satyam
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best classes I ever had. All the teachers were super friendly, patient and helpful and the course materials were so good....
After completing all 9 courses and now I know I have basic knowledge of a lot of fields like digital marketing,  UX, finance, consultancy and more, I feel more comfortable.

I'm sad though that there are not any more courses I can do as I finished them all coz it was the best 1 hour of my whole day interacting with my teachers and batch mates...
And made some really good friends through the courses...
